description:
On July 15th, 2022, officers responded to a 911 call about a domestic disturbance from a neighbour. They advised that a female was yelling and physically attacking a male. Eventually, the male was identified, cleared and released from the scene. 

The female also tried to bribe the officer. 

The female was charged with criminal damage to property, assault upon a peace officer, battery upon a peace officer, resisting arrest, and domestic battery.
